{{nihongo|'''Tanakurahiko Shrine'''|棚倉孫神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamashiro Province]].

'''Tanakurahiko Shrine''' (たなくらひこじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Kyōtanabe|ar|كيوتانابي (كيوتو)|azb|کیوتانابه|ce|Кётанабе|ceb|Kyōtanabe, Kyoto|de|Kyōtanabe|eo|Kjotanabe|es|Kyōtanabe (Kioto)|fa|کیوتانابه|fi|Kyōtanabe|fr|Kyōtanabe|gl|Kyōtanabe|hy|Կյոտանաբե|id|Kyōtanabe, Kyōto|it|Kyōtanabe|ja|京田辺市|ko|교타나베시|lt|Kiotanabė|my|ခယောတနဘဲ၊ ကျိုတို|nl|Kyotanabe|pl|Kyōtanabe|pt|Kyotanabe|ro|Kyōtanabe|ru|Кётанабе|simple|Kyōtanabe, Kyoto|sv|Kyōtanabe|tg|Кётанабе|tl|Kyōtanabe, Kyoto|tr|Kyōtanabe|tt|Кётанабе|uk|Кьо-Танабе|ur|کیوٹانا بے|vi|Kyōtanabe, Kyōto|war|Kyōtanabe, Kyoto|zh|京田邊市|zh_classical|京田邊市|zh_min_nan|Kyôtanabe-chhī|zh_yue|京田邊|qid=Q816728}}, {{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|Q120730|qid=Q120730}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinai Taisha|ja|式内大社|simple|Shikinai Taisha|qid=Q134917288}}, and its former shrine rank was gōsha.

=== History ===
=== Outline ===
According to shrine tradition, it was invited in {{ill|Empress Suiko|ar|الإمبراطورة سويكو|ast|Emperatriz Suiko|azb|امپراتریس سویکو|bcl|Emperatris Suiko|be|Імператрыца Суйка|ca|Suiko|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر سویکۆ|cs|Suiko|de|Suiko|es|Suiko Tennō|eu|Suiko|fa|امپراتریس سوئیکو|fi|Suiko|fr|Suiko|hak|Suiko Thiên-fòng|he|סויקו, קיסרית יפן|hu|Szuiko japán császárnő|id|Suiko|it|Suiko|ja|推古天皇|ka|სუიკო|ko|스이코 천황|la|Suiko (imperatrix)|nl|Suiko|pl|Suiko|pt|Suiko|ru|Императрица Суйко|sh|Carica Suiko|simple|Empress Suiko|sl|Cesarica Suiko|sv|Suiko|ta|பேரரசி சுய்கோ|th|จักรพรรดินีซูอิโกะ|tl|Emperatris Suiko|tr|Suiko (imparatoriçe)|uk|Імператор Суйко|uz|Imperator Suiko|vi|Thiên hoàng Suiko|zh|推古天皇|zh_classical|推古天皇|zh_min_nan|Suiko Thian-hông|zh_yue|推古天皇|qid=Q298057}} 31 ({{ill|623|ab|623|af|623|am|623 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|623|ar|623|ary|623|ast|623|avk|623|az|623|azb|۶۲۳ (میلادی)|be|623|be_x_old|623|bg|623|bn|৬২৩|bpy|মারি ৬২৩|br|623|bs|623.|ca|623|cdo|623 nièng|ceb|623|ckb|٦٢٣|crh|623|cs|623|cv|623|cy|623|da|623|de|623|el|623|eml|623|eo|623|es|623|et|623|eu|623|fa|۶۲۳ (میلادی)|fi|623|fo|623|fr|623|frr|623|fy|623|ga|623|gan|623年|gd|623|gl|623|he|623|hi|623|ht|623 (almanak jilyen)|hu|623|hy|623|id|623|io|623|it|623|ja|623年|jv|623|ka|623|kk|623 жыл|ko|623년|la|623|lb|623|lij|623|lmo|623|lt|623 m.|map_bms|623|mdf|623|mg|623|mhr|623|mk|623|mr|इ.स. ६२३|mrj|623 и|ms|623|mzn|۶۲۳|nah|623|nap|623|nds|623|new|सन् ६२३|nl|623|nn|623|no|623|nso|623|oc|623|or|୬୨୩|os|623-æм аз|pl|623|pnb|623|pt|623|qu|623|ro|623|ru|623 год|rue|623|sa|६२३|sah|623 сыл|scn|623|sd|623ع|se|623|sh|623.|shn|623|si|623|simple|623|sk|623|sl|623|sq|623|sr|623|su|623|sv|623|sw|623|tg|Соли 623|th|พ.ศ. 1166|tk|623|tl|623|tly|623|tr|623|tt|623 ел|uk|623|ur|623ء|uz|623|vec|623|vi|623|war|623|wuu|623年|xmf|623|zh|623年|zh_min_nan|623 nî|zh_yue|623年|qid=Q31044}}) from Tanakura-no-shō in {{ill|Sōraku District, Kyoto|Q1154661|qid=Q1154661}}. In the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'', it was listed as a major shrine. In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}} it was called "Tenmangū." In {{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 6 ({{ill|1931|Q18782|qid=Q18782}}), in {{ill|February|Q109|qid=Q109}}, it was ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Divine rank ===
*{{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611|lt=Ten'an}} 3 ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}), {{ill|January 27|Q2284|qid=Q2284}}: promoted from Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade (''{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}}'') - listed as "Tanakurahiko-no-kami"

=== Cultural properties ===
*Main sanctuary ({{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|Q120730|qid=Q120730}} {{ill|Registered Tangible Cultural Property of Japan|Q11579194|qid=Q11579194}})
Built in the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Momoyama period}}.
*Zuiki mikoshi ({{ill|Kyōtanabe|ar|كيوتانابي (كيوتو)|azb|کیوتانابه|ce|Кётанабе|ceb|Kyōtanabe, Kyoto|de|Kyōtanabe|eo|Kjotanabe|es|Kyōtanabe (Kioto)|fa|کیوتانابه|fi|Kyōtanabe|fr|Kyōtanabe|gl|Kyōtanabe|hy|Կյոտանաբե|id|Kyōtanabe, Kyōto|it|Kyōtanabe|ja|京田辺市|ko|교타나베시|lt|Kiotanabė|my|ခယောတနဘဲ၊ ကျိုတို|nl|Kyotanabe|pl|Kyōtanabe|pt|Kyotanabe|ro|Kyōtanabe|ru|Кётанабе|simple|Kyōtanabe, Kyoto|sv|Kyōtanabe|tg|Кётанабе|tl|Kyōtanabe, Kyoto|tr|Kyōtanabe|tt|Кётанабе|uk|Кьо-Танабе|ur|کیوٹانا بے|vi|Kyōtanabe, Kyōto|war|Kyōtanabe, Kyoto|zh|京田邊市|zh_classical|京田邊市|zh_min_nan|Kyôtanabe-chhī|zh_yue|京田邊|qid=Q816728}} Intangible Cultural Property)
For the annual festival, a zuiki mikoshi is made using taro stalks, chili peppers, kumquats, globe amaranth, white rice, beans, etc., and it parades through the ujiko district on {{ill|October|Q124|qid=Q124}} {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Health and Sports Day}}.
